mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(customer_group) AS keyCode, TRIM(customer_group) AS keyName FROM t_sr_strategy_key_audience WHERE tab_type = 'active' AND strategy_class = '重点客群' AND is_deleted = 0 AND customer_group IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(customer_group) != '' ORDER BY keyName

SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(s.small_category) AS keyCode, TRIM(s.small_category) AS keyName FROM t_sr_strategy_period_summary_ctrl s WHERE s.is_deleted = 0 AND s.strategy_id IS NOT NULL AND s.strategy_id != '999' AND s.small_category IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(s.small_category) != '' AND s.small_category != '全部' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM v_sr_strategy_read product WHERE product.strategy_code = s.strategy_id AND product.tab_type = 'control' AND product.is_deleted = 0) ORDER BY keyName

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(s.stat_month, '%Y-%m') AS statMonth,
s.channel AS channel, s.big_category AS bigCategory, s.small_category AS smallCategory,
COUNT(DISTINCT s.strategy_id) AS strategyCount, COUNT(1) AS metricRowCount, SUM(s.push_count) AS consultCount, SUM(s.usage_count) AS retainCount, SUM(s.reach_count) AS dispatchCount, SUM(s.product_conv_num) AS successCount, COUNT(s.push_count) AS consultKnownRows, COUNT(s.usage_count) AS retainKnownRows, COUNT(s.reach_count) AS dispatchKnownRows, COUNT(s.product_conv_num) AS successKnownRows, SUM(s.actual_income) AS income
COUNT(1) AS strategyCount, SUM(s.original_cust) AS originalCust, SUM(s.push_count) AS pushCount, SUM(s.usage_count) AS usageCount, SUM(s.reach_count) AS reachCount, SUM(s.target_conv_num) AS targetConvNum, SUM(s.product_conv_num) AS productConvNum, SUM(s.expected_income) AS expectedIncome, SUM(s.actual_income) AS actualIncome, SUM(s.reject_count) AS rejectCount
FROM s WHERE GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(s.stat_month, '%Y-%m')
, s.channel , s.big_category, s.small_category
ORDER BY statMonth
SELECT DAY(MAX(d.stat_date)) FROM d WHERE AND DATE_FORMAT(d.stat_date, '%Y-%m') = #{query.statMonth}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(d.stat_date, '%Y-%m') AS statMonth,
d.channel AS channel, d.big_category AS bigCategory, d.small_category AS smallCategory,
COUNT(1) AS strategyCount, COUNT(DISTINCT d.stat_date) AS dayCount, MIN(DAY(d.stat_date)) AS minDay, MAX(DAY(d.stat_date)) AS maxDay, SUM(d.original_cust) AS originalCust, SUM(d.push_count) AS pushCount, SUM(d.usage_count) AS usageCount, SUM(d.reach_count) AS reachCount, SUM(d.target_conv_num) AS targetConvNum, SUM(d.product_conv_num) AS productConvNum, SUM(d.expected_income) AS expectedIncome, SUM(d.actual_income) AS actualIncome, SUM(d.reject_count) AS rejectCount FROM d WHERE AND DATE_FORMAT(d.stat_date, '%Y-%m') IN (#{previousMonth}, #{query.statMonth}) AND DAY(d.stat_date) <= #{cutoffDay} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(d.stat_date, '%Y-%m')
, d.channel , d.big_category, d.small_category
ORDER BY statMonth

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(s.stat_month, '%Y-%m') AS statMonth, b.biz_name AS bizName, SUM(b.count) AS capacity FROM b JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT s.strategy_id, s.stat_month, s.city_id, s.county_id FROM s WHERE ) s ON s.strategy_id = b.strategy_id AND b.tab_type = #{query.tabType} AND s.city_id <=> b.city_id AND s.county_id <=> b.county_id AND DATE_FORMAT(s.stat_month, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(b.stat_date, '%Y-%m') WHERE b.is_deleted = 0 AND b.biz_name != '全部' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(s.stat_month, '%Y-%m'), b.biz_name ORDER BY statMonth, capacity DESC
